title: 携手开启中博全面战略合作伙伴关系新篇章（大使随笔）
title_en: Joining Hands to Open a New Chapter in the China-Botswana Comprehensive Strategic Cooperative Partnership (Ambassador's Essay)
summary: 博茨瓦纳总统博科应习近平主席邀请首次访华，正值中博建交51周年。两国元首会谈并发表联合声明，将双边关系提升为全面战略合作伙伴关系。双方同意增进政治互信，博方重申坚定奉行一个中国原则，支持联大第2758号决议，赞赏中方提出的全球倡议。党际交往
summary_en: Botswana President Boko made his first visit to China at the invitation of President Xi Jinping, coinciding with the 51st anniversary of China-Botswana diplomatic relations. The two heads of state held talks and issued a joint statement, upgrading bilateral relations to a comprehensive strategic cooperative partnership. The two sides agreed to enhance political mutual trust; Botswana reaffirmed its firm commitment to the one-China principle, supported UN General Assembly Resolution 2758, and appreciated China's global initiatives. Party-to-party exchanges.

title: 非洲咖啡“香飘”中国（进博会故事）
title_en: African Coffee Aroma Drifts to China (CIIE Stories)
summary: 进博会平台叠加中国对非洲建交国零关税政策红利，推动非洲咖啡加速进入中国市场。乌干达、肯尼亚等国咖啡企业连续参展，结识中国合作伙伴、签订合作备忘录，并借助进博会链接全产业链资源、拓展国际市场。自今年5月1日起，中国对53个非洲建交国全面实施零
summary_en: The CIIE platform, combined with China's zero-tariff policy for African countries with diplomatic relations, is accelerating the entry of African coffee into the Chinese market. Coffee companies from Uganda, Kenya and other countries have participated in consecutive expos, met Chinese partners, signed cooperation memorandums, and used the CIIE to link resources across the entire industrial chain and expand international markets. Since May 1 this year, China has fully implemented zero tariffs for 53 African countries with diplomatic relations.

title: 进博会“朋友圈”再扩容
title_en: CIIE Expands Its 'Circle of Friends' Further
summary: 第九届进博会开幕首日，69个国家和国际组织亮相国家展。加拿大馆以原木色和多种木材展示自然资源与设计特色；斯里兰卡馆带来锡兰红茶、香料、椰子制品等，希望融入中国产业链并拓展家电、信息通信等领域合作；塞尔维亚馆用玩具陈设讲述文化故事，促进两国民
summary_en: On the opening day of the 9th CIIE, 69 countries and international organizations appeared at the national exhibition. The Canada Pavilion showcased natural resources and design features with log colors and various woods; the Sri Lanka Pavilion brought Ceylon black tea, spices, coconut products, etc., hoping to integrate into China's industrial chain and expand cooperation in home appliances and information communication; the Serbia Pavilion used toy displays to tell cultural stories and promote people-to-people bonds.

title: 共同擘画新时代中多命运共同体的美好蓝图（大使随笔）
title_en: Jointly drawing a beautiful blueprint for a China-Togo community with a shared future in the new era (Ambassador's Journal)
summary: 10月，习近平主席在北京会见多哥部长会议主席福雷，双方宣布将双边关系定位提升为新时代中多命运共同体，发表联合声明并签署15项合作协议。建交54年来，中多始终相互尊重、团结协作，多哥坚定恪守一个中国原则，支持人类命运共同体理念和全球倡议。习近
summary_en: In October, President Xi Jinping met with Togo's Prime Minister Faure in Beijing. The two sides announced the elevation of bilateral relations to a China-Togo community with a shared future in the new era, issued a joint statement, and signed 15 cooperation agreements. Over 54 years of diplomatic relations, China and Togo have always respected each other and worked together; Togo firmly adheres to the One-China principle and supports the concept of a community with a shared future for mankind and global initiatives.

title: 澜沧江—湄公河合作第十一次外长会在北京举行
title_en: 11th Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Foreign Ministers' Meeting held in Beijing
summary: 澜沧江—湄公河合作第十一次外长会在北京举行。王毅表示，今年是澜湄合作首次领导人会议召开十周年，十年来该合作成为区域合作“金色样板”，惠及六国民众，助力各国现代化。各方将推进澜湄合作2.0版，开启新的“金色十年”。王毅提出团结自强、开放共赢、
summary_en: The 11th Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Foreign Ministers' Meeting was held in Beijing. Wang Yi said this year marks the 10th anniversary of the first Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Leaders' Meeting; over the past decade, the cooperation has become a 'golden model' of regional cooperation, benefiting people in the six countries and supporting their modernization. The parties will advance Lancang-Mekong Cooperation 2.0 and open a new 'golden decade.' Wang Yi proposed unity and self-strengthening, openness and win-win cooperation.
